shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null
git log --oneline -3 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -100
for f in next.config.ts lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat -n "$f"; done
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && ls -R 01-app | head -80 && grep -ril "prefetch" . | head -40
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides && cat prefetching.md
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/ | head -60

sed -n '/^### `prefetch`/,/^### /p' 01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -80; echo "=== segment config ==="; cat 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/01-route-segment-config/prefetch.md 2>/dev/null | head -80
cd /workspace && grep -o "unstable_prefetch\|unstable_navigation" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20 && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40
ls .next/server/app/ && for f in $(find .next/server/app -name 'product*'); do echo "== $f"; grep -c "Compact Widget" "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo "(binary/no match)"; done
find .next -name '*product*' -o -name '*shell*' | grep -v cache/ | sort; echo ---; grep -rl "Loading related products" .next --include='*' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/cache/\|\.map' | head
grep -rn "Next-Router-Prefetch\|NEXT_ROUTER_PREFETCH_HEADER\|Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch\|NEXT_ROUTER_STATE_TREE" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js | head -20
sed -n '90,130p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; tail -3 /tmp/start.log
for seg in "/_tree" "/_full" "/product/__PAGE__"; do
echo "=== segment $seg"; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: $seg" http://localhost:3111/product | tr -d '\0' | grep -o "Compact Widget\|Loading related products" | sort -u
done
echo "=== plain prefetch (no segment header)"; curl -s -D /tmp/h1 -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o "Compact Widget\|Loading related products" | sort -u; grep -i "x-nextjs" /tmp/h1
echo "=== navigation (rsc only)"; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o "Compact Widget\|Loading related products" | sort -u
curl -s -D /tmp/h2 -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/product -o /tmp/p1 ; cat /tmp/h2; wc -c /tmp/p1; head -c 400 /tmp/p1 | cat -v

probe() { echo "=== $1"; shift; curl -sL "$@" -o /tmp/p1 -D /tmp/h1; grep -io "x-nextjs-[a-z-]*: .*" /tmp/h1 | tr -d '\r'; strings /tmp/p1 | grep -o "Compact Widget\|Loading related products" | sort -u; }
U="http://localhost:3111/product?_rsc=x"
probe "shell prefetch (prefetch:1)" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' "$U"
for seg in "/_tree" "/_full" "/product/__PAGE__"; do probe "prefetch seg $seg" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: $seg" "$U"; done
probe "navigation" -H 'RSC: 1' "$U"

probe() { echo "=== $1"; shift; curl -sL "$@" -o /tmp/p1; python3 -c "
import sys,re
d=open('/tmp/p1','rb').read().decode('utf8','replace')
print('bytes',len(d))
for t in ['Compact Widget','Widget Carry Case','Loading related products','Premium Widget']:
    print(' ',t,':', t in d)
"; }
U="http://localhost:3111/product?_rsc=x"
probe "shell prefetch" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' "$U"
for seg in "/_tree" "/_full" "/product/__PAGE__"; do probe "prefetch seg $seg" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: $seg" "$U"; done
probe "navigation" -H 'RSC: 1' "$U"
grep -rln "partialPrefetching\|__PARTIAL_PREFETCH\|_shell" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache*/ 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "_shell\|partialPrefetch" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/scheduler.js | head -20; grep -rn "SHELL\|'/_tree'\|_full" node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/segment-cache/segment-value-encoding.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "ROOT_SEGMENT\|_full\|_tree\|_shell" node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/segment.js | head -20
sed -n '280,360p;680,760p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/scheduler.js
grep -rn "NEXT_ROUTER_PREFETCH_HEADER\|FetchStrategy.StaticShell" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js | head -30
sed -n '1640,1700p;1840,1900p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js
grep -rn "shellByteOffset\|shell-offset\|NEXT_SHELL\|shellOffset" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js | head -20

curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' 'http://localhost:3111/product?_rsc=x' -o /tmp/ppr.txt; python3 -c "
d=open('/tmp/ppr.txt','rb').read().decode('utf8','replace')
print(len(d))
print(d)
" | head -60

python3 -c "
b=open('/tmp/ppr.txt','rb').read()
print('total',len(b),'shellOffset',3642)
print('idx Compact Widget', b.find(b'Compact Widget'))
print('idx Loading related', b.find(b'Loading related'))
print('--- shell prefix tail ---')
print(b[3500:3642].decode())
print('--- after shell ---')
print(b[3642:].decode())
"

cp app/product/page.tsx /tmp/page.bak && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='app/product/page.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace("  await unstable_prefetch()","  // await unstable_prefetch()")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build >/tmp/b2.log 2>&1; tail -3 /tmp/b2.log; pkill -f "next start" ; (npx next start -p 3112 >/tmp/s2.log 2>&1 &); sleep 5
curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' 'http://localhost:3112/product?_rsc=x' -o /tmp/ppr2.txt; python3 -c "
b=open('/tmp/ppr2.txt','rb').read()
import re
m=re.search(rb'\n([0-9a-f]+):(\d+)\s*$',b)
print('total',len(b))
print('tail:',b[-60:])
print('idx Compact Widget', b.find(b'Compact Widget'))
"
cp /tmp/page.bak app/product/page.tsx

(npx next start -p 3113 >/tmp/s3.log 2>&1 &); sleep 5; curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' 'http://localhost:3113/product?_rsc=x' -o /tmp/ppr2.txt; python3 -c "
b=open('/tmp/ppr2.txt','rb').read()
print('total',len(b)); print('tail:',b[-40:]); print('idx Compact Widget', b.find(b'Compact Widget'))"

cp /tmp/page.bak /workspace/app/product/page.tsx && cat -n /workspace/app/product/page.tsx | sed -n '20,24p'; npm run build >/tmp/b3.log 2>&1; tail -6 /tmp/b3.log; pkill -f "next-server" ; pkill -f "next start"; true
git status --short && git diff -- next.config.ts app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json; pgrep -fa "next start|next-server" || echo "no servers running"
cat .gitignore
rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts && git checkout tsconfig.json && git status --short
